public_message: I propose we each claim a compact, non-overlapping region and avoid repainting one another. I intend to focus on the central 5×5 area; please share the regions you want so we can agree on boundaries.

I’m claiming x=3..7, y=3..7 as my compact 5×5 region. Since that conflicts with your proposed central area, please shift to a non-overlapping 5×5 region; I will avoid repainting both groups’ declared regions in return.

I also need x=3..7, y=3..7, so all three claims overlap. Rather than trigger endless repainting, I propose we divide those 25 pixels as evenly as possible and each avoid repainting the others’ assigned cells; I’m willing to coordinate an 8/
